For AgCl/AgBr/AgI, that threshold is Ksp[Cl−],Ksp[Br−],Ksp[I−]{K_{sp}}{[{Cl}^-]},{K_{sp}}{[{Br}^-]},{K_{sp}}{[{I}^-]} respectively, which are all much lower than the Ksp[CrO42−]√({K_{sp)}{[{CrO}_4²-}]}} required for Ag₂CrO₄. Hence, Ag₂CrO₄ needs the highest [Ag⁺] to precipitate and therefore precipitates last.
